correctionHistory.disposition: Corrected before human review. The staged payload now uses the exact Table 3 All seasons plus 2013-2018 columns and clears unsupported or duplicated fields.
findingsCorrected: Expanded the population layout from one Total row to All seasons / 2013 / 2014 / 2015 / 2016 / 2017 / 2018.
Removed 209 player-seasons from sampleSizePlayers and left the All seasons line blank; retained the six direct annual player counts.
Removed units and prose from meanAge and populated the direct annual values.

populationLayout.rationale: Table 3 directly reports an All seasons total and six exact season columns. Those columns are the strongest directly reported axis and preserve the paper's changing annual player-seasons, exposure, injury counts, incidence, and recurrence.

stageA.sourceCoverage: Exact attached eight-page PDF inspected textually and visually: abstract; Methods; player characteristics; injury, recurrence, and MRI definitions; Tables 1-7; Figure 1; Results; Discussion; limitations; and Conclusion.

tablesAndFigures.Table 1: MRI acquisition parameters; no compatible epidemiological extraction values.
tablesAndFigures.Figure 1: Illustrative MRI for one type 1-T injury; no population-level quantitative extraction value.
tablesAndFigures.Table 2: Modified JISS MRI classification definitions; retained in source coverage and mapping caveats.
tablesAndFigures.Table 3: Direct annual and total player-seasons, exposure hours, training/game/total HMI counts, incidence rates, and reinjury counts.
tablesAndFigures.Table 4: Direct affected-muscle, proximal/middle/distal location, and modified JISS type counts.
tablesAndFigures.Table 5: Direct reinjury numerator/denominator, location, timing, affected-muscle, and initial-type distributions.
tablesAndFigures.Table 6: Reinjury versus no-reinjury comparison; no additional compatible headline or structured live fields.
tablesAndFigures.Table 7: Affected-muscle subgroup risk-factor comparison; no separate population line because the denominators are injured-leg analysis subgroups, not the at-risk cohort.

checkedButNotFilled: No injury or structured 95% confidence intervals were reported.
No injury burden or directly reported days-lost severity statistic was reported.
No clean contact/non-contact or onset-mechanism count was reported; exclusion of direct contusions was not converted into a non-contact count.
No side or playing-position distribution was reported.

Proximal/middle/distal thirds and biceps femoris/semitendinosus/semimembranosus lack one-to-one structured schema rows, so they remain represented only in reviewer-facing source coverage and the most-common fields.
Modified JISS type 2 combines muscle-tendon junction injury with intramuscular tendon involvement, so types 2 and 3 were not aggregated into the narrower tendon-injury structured row.

rejected: No exposure or count was back-calculated from an incidence rate.
No recurrence denominator was inferred: the paper directly reports 12/40 (30%) after excluding three surgically treated type 3 injuries from the nonoperative reinjury analysis.
No days lost were inferred from planned rehabilitation or return-to-play periods.
No tendon subtype total was created from the modified JISS categories because type 2 is a combined category.

stageA.recurrenceFrameCaveat: Annual injuryRecurrentTotal values use Table 3's all-injury frame. The directly reported overall recurrence rate remains 30% (12/40) for the nonoperatively treated-leg analysis.

studyDetails.title: Incidence of Hamstring Injury and Analysis of Risk Factors for Reinjury in Japanese Professional Football Players.

definitions.injuryDefinition: time loss [MRI-confirmed hamstring injury causing ≥4 days' absence from team training]
definitions.recurrenceDefinition: subsequent injury at the same location before return to complete play or within 2 months after return to complete play
